"""Drive the formal page in a real Qt event loop and capture public examples."""

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
os.environ["QT_QPA_PLATFORM"] = "offscreen"
from qr_app.presentation.qt_environment import configure_qt_environment
configure_qt_environment()
from PyQt5.QtCore import QTimer
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QMainWindow
from qr_app.service import QRService
from qr_app.presentation.gui import main

snapshot = ROOT / "tmp/gui_pre_publish/known.png"
failure_snapshot = ROOT / "tmp/gui_pre_publish/error.png"
png = ROOT / "tmp/gui_pre_publish/saved.png"
out = ROOT / "tmp/gui_pre_publish/result.json"
assert not any(p.exists() for p in (snapshot, failure_snapshot, png, out))
checks = {k: False for k in ("starts_empty", "typing_does_not_generate", "known_success",
    "save_does_not_generate", "save_keeps_canvas", "draft_marked_and_save_disabled",
    "clear_changes_only_draft", "failure_clears_image", "partial_steps_visible", "recovers_at_capacity", "cycle_complete")}
record = {"checks": checks, "errors": [], "known_request": None}
original_show = QMainWindow.show
original_generate = QRService.generate_qr
generated = None

def protect(function, window):
    def guarded():
        try:
            function()
        except Exception as error:
            record["errors"].append({"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
            window.close()
    return guarded

def shown(window):
    original_show(window)
    panel = window.generation_panel
    def generate_known():
        checks["starts_empty"] = panel.input_text() == "" and not panel.save_button.isEnabled()
        panel.text_input.setPlainText("known")
        checks["typing_does_not_generate"] = generated.call_count == 0
        panel.generate_button.click()
        checks["known_success"] = panel.state == "success" and panel.save_button.isEnabled()
        record["known_request"] = {"id": panel.submitted_request.request_id, "text": panel.submitted_request.text,
                                   "result_id": panel.last_result.request_id, "steps": len(panel.last_result.trace_steps)}
        QTimer.singleShot(150, protect(save_and_edit, window))

    def save_and_edit():
        assert window.grab().save(str(snapshot))
        canvas = panel.canvas
        result = panel.last_result
        with patch("qr_app.presentation.png_dialog.QFileDialog.getSaveFileName", return_value=(str(png), "PNG image (*.png)")), \
                patch("qr_app.presentation.png_dialog.QMessageBox.information"), \
                patch("qr_app.presentation.png_dialog.QMessageBox.warning") as warning:
            panel.save_button.click()
        assert not warning.called and png.exists()
        checks["save_does_not_generate"] = generated.call_count == 1
        checks["save_keeps_canvas"] = panel.canvas is canvas and panel.last_result is result
        panel.text_input.setPlainText("new draft")
        checks["draft_marked_and_save_disabled"] = panel.state == "editing" and not panel.save_button.isEnabled()
        panel.clear_button.click()
        checks["clear_changes_only_draft"] = panel.input_text() == "" and panel.last_result is result and generated.call_count == 1
        panel.text_input.setPlainText("Sugarplum_Fairy_Nightmare")
        panel.generate_button.click()
        checks["failure_clears_image"] = panel.state == "failure" and not panel.save_button.isEnabled() and len(panel.axes.images) == 0
        checks["partial_steps_visible"] = "Completed steps: 1" in panel.details_label.text()
        QTimer.singleShot(150, protect(capture_failure, window))

    def capture_failure():
        assert window.grab().save(str(failure_snapshot))
        panel.text_input.setPlainText("A" * 17)
        panel.generate_button.click()
        checks["recovers_at_capacity"] = panel.last_result.generation_success and panel.save_button.isEnabled() and generated.call_count == 3
        import numpy as np
        panel.text_input.setPlainText("Hello\nQR")
        panel.generate_button.click()
        first = panel.last_result.matrix.copy()
        newline = next(s.payload for s in panel.last_result.trace_steps if s.step_id == "input.iso_8859_1")
        newline_input = panel.submitted_request.text
        panel.text_input.setPlainText("Hello QR")
        panel.generate_button.click()
        space = next(s.payload for s in panel.last_result.trace_steps if s.step_id == "input.iso_8859_1")
        record["newline_vs_space"] = {"newline_input": newline_input, "newline_hex": newline.hex(" "),
            "space_input": panel.submitted_request.text, "space_hex": space.hex(" "),
            "different_matrices": not bool(np.array_equal(first, panel.last_result.matrix))}
        checks["newline_vs_space"] = (newline == b"Hello\nQR" and space == b"Hello QR"
                                      and record["newline_vs_space"]["different_matrices"])
        checks["cycle_complete"] = True
        QTimer.singleShot(100, window.close)

    QTimer.singleShot(150, protect(generate_known, window))

with patch.object(QMainWindow, "show", shown), \
        patch.object(QRService, "generate_qr", autospec=True, side_effect=original_generate) as generated:
    exit_code = main(["--offscreen", "--close-after-ms", "6000"])
record["exit_code"] = exit_code
record["generation_calls"] = generated.call_count
record["artifacts"] = {"success_window": str(snapshot), "failure_window": str(failure_snapshot), "saved_png": str(png)}
record["all_passed"] = exit_code == 0 and all(checks.values()) and not record["errors"]
out.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
sys.exit(0 if record["all_passed"] else 1)
